recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future edits in this area should preserve affectsState as the current element name and apply later method-support decisions instead of restoring idempotent terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-13018 asked to replace OperationDefinition.idempotent semantics because HTTP idempotent methods such as DELETE can still affect state; the Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution renamed the element to affectsState, updated the definition, and noted STU3-to-STU4 conversion should negate existing values.
initial_application: The Jira application comment points to svn revision 12727. Git-svn commit 50ff76d9cb4d07379bbd6cd2aab33b8b330acf26 renamed the then-authoritative OperationDefinition spreadsheet element to affectsState and updated source/operations.html from idempotent wording to affectsState=false wording. Git-svn commit 000f9318213d7bbd6df221ec25f8cb296baca153 applied the rename through generated R4 Java model, parser, and conversion code.
additional_context: Later final decisions refined the same area: FHIR-14960 clarified POST/GET method support for affectsState-based operations, FHIR-18197 removed the remaining HTTP idempotent reference from affectsState, and FHIR-51046 updated the Operations GET parameter criterion to datatypes with corresponding search types. OperationDefinition and operations.html are active build inputs, and source/fhir.ini's OperationDefinition.idempotent=OperationDefinition.affectsState line is migration metadata rather than current element guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current OperationDefinition.affectsState has a direct state-effect definition and method-support comment, current Operations prose uses affectsState=false with URL/search-type representability for GET invocation, and the active FHIR ModelInfo Library lists affectsState.

related_jiras.note: Clarified POST and GET method support for affectsState-based operations after the rename; already represented on the combined branch.
Removed the remaining HTTP idempotent reference from OperationDefinition.affectsState; already represented on the combined branch.
Updated the Operations-page GET parameter criterion to datatypes with corresponding search types; already represented on the combined branch.
